method.label: Separate inputs by sign and integrality

annotationRationale: The range follows from exact floor values in three exhaustive cases, using absolute-value simplification within each case.
sourceMethod: Follows the official cases for nonnegative inputs, negative integers, and negative nonintegers. The last case is clarified by writing x=-k-t.

review.mathCheck: Independently, nonnegative inputs and negative integers give 0. For x=-k-t with k≥0 integer and 0<t<1, the two terms are k and k+1, giving -1. These cases exhaust the domain, and inputs 0 and -1/2 attain both outputs. The range is {-1,0}, choice A, matching the key.
review.sourceMethodCheck: The attached MAA solution 9 uses the same three cases. The candidate faithfully adapts that approach in original wording, explaining negative nonintegers through k and t and explicitly verifying attainment.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed floor concept and supporting absolute-value concept fit the actual calculations. All endpoints and cases are explained sufficiently for AMC 10. No material omission or incorrect direct node.
